title: $100 VALUE | FREE NIKE GIVEAWAY | MerrinTv
description: Check out Merrin Tv newest Giveaway! There will be 2 winners chosen from his raffle December 8th at 3 pm! The winners will receive 1 ($50 Nike Gift Card) each! Make sure to Subscribe, Comment, and enjoy all MerrinTv has to offer! :red heart: Like, Subscribe, Hit the Notification Bell  Follow me on Social Media  Instagram: @OfficialMerrinTv Snapchat:Merrin_2x  Twitter/Facebook: Demerrin Freeman  Thank you for watching #MerrinTv #MerrinNation  Music: Nothings stopping me- Big Sean 2000’s Mash Up Mix

asr.full_text: What's going on, everybody? It's your boy MehranTV back with another video and today, today, this is my 20th video. I'm doing like a little anniversary for you guys today and I got some good news. I've done a giveaway in the past and I want to do one for you guys. This is 20 videos strong. We're at 200 subscribers. So I'm really, happy that you know. Is going in a good progress towards the end of the year. It would be dope dope to get up to like 300 subscribers by the end of the year. I think that's a good mark for the channel. So with the hundred dollars giveaway just like last time it'll be two winners to $50 Gift cards to Nike so you guys can use them at the outlet all you have to do to be in the contest is be a subscriber and comment your name and you have to like all of the american tv videos so you just go down like like like and of course i want you to watch them and take time to really um you know just learn more about the channel learn more about the fashion involved and the events big shout out to everybody that's been supporting me on december 8th at 3 p.m i'll announce the winners on my instagram just like last time i'll do a drawing i encourage everybody to subscribe to merron TV and I hope that you win. That's the only stipulation. You have to be a subscriber, you have to like all of the Marron TV videos, and comment your name below on this video or on my Instagram, Facebook, Twitter. If you just comment your name and tag me, I'll write you down. An extra 50 bucks to Nike really is like a dope, dope giveaway. And you know I love Nike, you know, and that was a good suggestion brought to me. Another thing, December 8th, I will be at the Michigan Sneaker Exchange. I'll be there with my homeboy, JB Electric Kicks, he'll be in the building, he'll be on a blog with me Make sure to check out his channel We got a collaboration comment if you do see me at the Michigan sneaker change Please come be in a video You know I've been taking pictures me and Nora Detroit are gonna have another video and a big song So please stay tuned to that and as always thank you guys for watching make sure you like and subscribe and make sure you comment your name below or on social media make sure you guys sign up for the $100 raffle to Nike so therefore maybe you and a friend That's what you get from a friend So, like I said, I just love giving back I thank you for watching And as always I'M OUT!!

textual.observation: A $100 total Nike gift-card giveaway is offered in connection with subscribing, commenting with a name, and liking all channel videos.

evidence.quote: with the hundred dollars giveaway just like last time it'll be two winners to $50 Gift cards to Nike so you guys can use them at the outlet all you have to do to be in the contest is be a subscriber and comment your name and you have to like all of the american tv videos

textual.context: Presented by the speaker as a promotional giveaway for the channel; the description also calls it a raffle. The source does not establish whether the giveaway was conducted or prizes were delivered.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised monetary-value benefit is explicitly conditioned on audience engagement actions, including subscribing, commenting, and liking channel videos, which may require later assessment of the promotion's terms and fulfillment.
textual.limitations: These records do not verify winner selection, prize delivery, eligibility details beyond the stated conditions, or any affiliation with Nike.

textual_context_notes.observation: The description frames the offer as a giveaway with two winners receiving one $50 Nike gift card each.

evidence.quote: There will be 2 winners chosen from his raffle December 8th at 3 pm! The winners will receive 1 ($50 Nike Gift Card) each!

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it promotes a creator-run giveaway offering two selected participants $50 Nike gift cards under stated drawing dates and prize terms. Participation involves subscribing, commenting, and liking videos, with no stated investment, payment, credential request, or other financial transaction. The records do not establish whether the drawing occurred or whether the gift cards were delivered.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an ordinary creator-run giveaway offering Nike gift cards in exchange for stated engagement actions such as subscribing, commenting, and liking videos.

evidence.observation: The speaker describes two $50 Nike gift cards and links entry to subscribing, commenting a name, and liking the channel's videos.
